Maya (Marketing): @Ravi @Katherine :wave: Hey runtime — need a focused bench spot-check for the launch blitz. Demo/webinar Friday EOD. Can you run a small reproducible smoke pack that covers embedding latency + long-context gen for quantized variants? Need method doc + artifact bundle we can hand to comms.
Ravi (Eng Runtime): Quick Qs — sample size? which models/quant configs? region and target SLOs? do you want cold-starts + warmed caches?
Maya (Marketing): Goal: ~500 queries stratified by length. Breakdown: 50 long (>8k tokens), 200 medium (2-8k), 250 short (<2k). Include 50 cold-start traces (no warmup) and warmed runs. Path to samples: gs://redwood-marketing/bench/launch-2026/samples.csv. Please attach seed list + provenance for each sample. Need run artifacts by Thu 12:00 PT.
Katherine (Bench Lead): We can run that. To hit Thu noon we need model names + quant flags by EOD today. We'll include token-level latency breakdown and percentile heatmap. Do you want prefix/KV cache warmup policy enabled for warmed runs? :+1:
Maya (Marketing): Models: Llama-3-32k (fp16), llama-3-32k-4bit (quantized via q4_0), embeddings: embed-large-v1. Yes include warmed (prefix+kv) and cold-start variants. Also include warmup protocol used (number of tokens, batch pattern). Please capture per-request trace_id so Data can map outputs.
Sofia (Data): I'll attach labeled seed list and expected-verbatim prompts. We'll also flag a small hallucination check set. I'll want trace_id mapping and the raw outputs (jsonl) with token timings.
Katherine (Bench Lead): Sounds good. We'll set deterministic RNG seed for gen runs and document exact binary/commit used. Runbook snippet we'll attach to artifacts:
```
commit: runtime@a1b2c3d
docker: gcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026-03-21
seed: 42
warmup: 3 runs of first 1024 tokens
quant: q4_0 (per-model config file attached)
```
bench-bot: Scheduled bench run BR-202603-001 for Thu 03/21 06:00PT on us-west1. ETA artifacts 6h after completion. Tracker: https://internal.redwood/bench/BR-202603-001
Katherine (Bench Lead): Running now against a tiny dev shard to verify configs, will post smoke logs here. If smoke looks good we'll flip to full sample.
Maya (Marketing): Awesome — thanks team. If anything blocks, ping me; can hop on 15min sync. :rocket:
